---
name: ble-desk-lamp
description: Control BLE Desk Lamp through the generated BLE device CLI.
---

Use `ble-desk-lamp-pp-cli capabilities --json` to inspect callable and withheld BLE capabilities, including safety classes and evidence refs. Use `ble-desk-lamp-pp-cli status --json` to inspect replay-backed status output. Use `ble-desk-lamp-pp-cli toggle --dry-run --json` to preview the toggle write. Live BLE control and optional session IPC are generated only when device-session support is enabled by the device spec.
